title: Eric Trump-backed robot soldier startup can't pay staff after founder borrowed $4.6 million from company to buy home
summary_full: Eric Trump-backed robot startup Foundation Future Industries has run low on cash and missed payroll, as CEO Sankaet Pathak faces scrutiny over a $4.6 million company loan.
